complications.name: Camera sweep
complications.text: A camera swivels and finds the crew standing very still in the open.
complications.absorbed_text: The camera swivels, finds nothing interesting and swivels back.
complications.flavor: It is a very slow camera. It is also a very judgemental one.

complications.name: The watchman stirs
complications.text: The night watchman stirs in his chair. Somebody was too loud.
complications.absorbed_text: The watchman half-opens one eye, hears nothing, and half-closes it.
complications.flavor: He mutters something about wanting to be a pastry chef.

complications.name: The watchman walks his rounds
complications.text: The now-awake watchman ambles down the corridor, flashlight swinging.
complications.absorbed_text: The watchman ambles right past, humming.
complications.flavor: He is humming a song about a lighthouse.

complications.name: School trip
complications.text: A school trip floods the gallery. Forty children, one very tired teacher.
complications.absorbed_text: The school trip is gently steered toward the gift shop.
complications.flavor: One child asks what the crew's names are. Three of the crew lie.

complications.name: A cat strolls in
complications.text: A cat strolls in as if it owns the place. It is not on the guest list.
complications.absorbed_text: The cat is offered a better spot and strolls off with great dignity.
complications.flavor: The cat has no comment.

complications.name: The vase falls
complications.text: The cat knocks a priceless-looking vase off its shelf. It lands loudly.
complications.absorbed_text: A quick hand catches the vase. The cat looks disappointed.
complications.flavor: The vase was a replica of a replica.

complications.name: Freshly mopped
complications.text: The cleaner has mopped the whole gallery and left no sign at all.
complications.absorbed_text: A very small, very quick woman mops up the mop-up.
complications.flavor: The sign is in the cleaner's pocket.

complications.name: The dust sheets come off
complications.text: Someone whips the dust sheets off the display. A great grey cloud rolls out.
complications.absorbed_text: A quick fan of a hat keeps the dust where it is.
complications.flavor: The dust has been waiting a long time for this.

complications.name: The alarm goes off
complications.text: The watchman sees the crew, shrieks, and pulls the alarm lever with great enthusiasm.
complications.absorbed_text: The watchman reaches for the lever and is handed a cup of tea instead.
complications.flavor: The alarm plays a jaunty tune. It is the same tune as the doorbell.

complications.name: The curator does a tour
complications.text: The curator wanders through, peering at every visitor and asking who invited them.
complications.absorbed_text: The curator is introduced to an enthusiastic 'new volunteer' and wanders off, flattered.
complications.flavor: She has a clipboard. She is not afraid to use it.

complications.name: Inspector Bramble drops by
complications.text: Inspector Bramble pops in to ask why a mug from the staff kitchen is in somebody's pocket.
complications.absorbed_text: Inspector Bramble is talked into a long tour of the building and forgets the question.
complications.flavor: Bramble has been inspecting this museum for eleven years and has never found anything.

complications.name: The pit boss does a lap
complications.text: The pit boss does a slow lap of the floor, squinting at every stranger in a bad jacket.
complications.absorbed_text: The pit boss is handed a drink by a very friendly stranger and forgets what he was squinting at.
complications.flavor: His moustache has its own security clearance.

complications.name: A high roller says hello
complications.text: A high roller swears he has met one of the crew before, at a wedding, in another country.
complications.absorbed_text: The high roller is steered to the buffet by someone with a lovely smile.
complications.flavor: He has not met anyone before. He says this a lot.

complications.name: The band strikes up
complications.text: The house band strikes up a very enthusiastic polka. Every pot and pan in the building hums along.
complications.absorbed_text: The polka starts, and nobody in the crew even flinches.
complications.flavor: The accordion player has a lot of opinions.

complications.name: A bouncer turns his head
complications.text: A very large bouncer hears the commotion and turns his very large head.
complications.absorbed_text: The bouncer glances over, sees only a band and a buffet, and turns back.
complications.flavor: He has a name tag that just says 'Sir'.

complications.name: A swell rocks the barge
complications.text: A passing ferry sends a swell under the barge. Every chip on every table slides an inch to the left.
complications.absorbed_text: The barge lurches, and a steady pair of hands keeps everything where it should be.
complications.flavor: The ferry's captain waves cheerfully.

complications.name: A seagull sees the haul
complications.text: A seagull dives out of nowhere, snatches a fistful of chips, and leaves with great dignity.
complications.absorbed_text: A sharp eye spots the seagull in time, and the haul stays in the bag.
complications.flavor: The seagull cashes in at a rival barge later that week.

complications.name: The cash cart blocks the way
complications.text: A trolley of cash chips wedges itself across the corridor, with a wobbly wheel and a very loud squeak.
complications.absorbed_text: The trolley is parked neatly out of the way, with no squeak.
complications.flavor: Its wheel has opinions about the polka.

complications.name: The auditor counts everything
complications.text: The casino auditor notices a small souvenir missing and begins, patiently, to count everything on the barge.
complications.absorbed_text: The auditor is taken to see a very fine view and loses count.
complications.flavor: He counts in his sleep.

complications.name: The fumes hit
complications.text: The aged-cheese fumes roll in like a wall of warm socks. Someone has to sit down.
complications.absorbed_text: A sharp eye sees the whiff coming and the whole crew breathes through their sleeves.
complications.flavor: The smell is described, by a crew member, as 'moist'.

complications.name: A parade of mice
complications.text: Forty mice march through in a very tidy line, squeaking, toward the good cheese.
complications.absorbed_text: The mice are gently redirected toward the snack table, squeaking approvingly.
complications.flavor: The lead mouse has a tiny hat.

complications.name: The humidity monitor beeps
complications.text: A humidity monitor starts beeping, because someone opened a door in the wrong order.
complications.absorbed_text: A quick hand resets the monitor before it finishes its second beep.
complications.flavor: The monitor has never beeped before and sounds embarrassed.

complications.name: A wheel rolls loose
complications.text: A cheese wheel the size of a tractor tyre rolls off its shelf and thunders away down the cellar steps.
complications.absorbed_text: Two strong arms catch the wheel, and the room breathes out.
complications.flavor: It rolls all the way to the car park, which is further than it sounds.

complications.name: The night affineur turns the wheels
complications.text: The night affineur shuffles through, turning wheels and tutting at the crew's footprints.
complications.absorbed_text: The affineur is asked about his favourite wheel and talks happily for ten minutes.
complications.flavor: He talks to the cheese. The cheese is a good listener.

complications.name: The trail leads home
complications.text: A very faint, very distinctive smell of cheese leads a keen-nosed inspector straight to the van.
complications.absorbed_text: The inspector is given a sample and loses the trail in joy.
complications.flavor: The inspector's nose is famous.
